anomalies.description: A group of armed men violently attack and subdue a person on the ground in a desert encampment; multiple attackers use sticks and physical force while others run toward or away from the struggle.

A chaotic group confrontation involving at least six individuals in a desert setting, with sustained aggressive physical interaction, dust clouds, and no clear authority presence—consistent with collective violent unrest.
A person is pinned and struck repeatedly on the ground by multiple assailants, appearing helpless and unable to defend themselves during the assault.

One individual is on the ground while multiple others surround and repeatedly strike or stomp on them; the victim appears unable to defend themselves, indicating targeted abuse rather than mutual combat.; A group of armed men surrounds and attacks a person lying on the ground in a desert; they are seen striking and kicking the prone individual, who appears helpless.
A group of men are engaged in a violent physical fight in a dusty desert environment; they are striking, grappling, and kicking each other, with dust kicked up by rapid movement.

One man in a green shirt appears to be actively striking or restraining the prone individual while others stand close; motion blur and posture suggest physical engagement, though the victim is already on the ground.

A group of armed men surrounds a person lying on the ground in a desert; at least two individuals are holding weapons (machetes or clubs) near the prone individual, suggesting an ongoing assault or execution.
A large-scale explosion occurs in the background, with multiple tents or structures detonating simultaneously, producing visible fireballs and smoke plumes.
